_comment: Presets consumed by vars_generator.py. A preset is a named selection. Presets are DISTRO-AGNOSTIC (they carry no distro-specific control ids); the distro (rhel9/rhel10) is chosen separately in the UI/API and resolves the matching catalog + variable prefix. 'tke_safe: true' auto-applies the TKE exception set (forwarding on, firewall none, /var mounts relaxed, SELinux permissive) regardless of other choices. A preset MAY set an optional "distro" to pin one.

tke-safe-full.label: TKE-Safe Full Hardening
tke-safe-full.description: All CIS sections enabled, with the curated Kubernetes exceptions so the image works as a TKE worker node. Recommended default.

level1-tke.label: Level 1 Only (TKE-safe)
level1-tke.description: Only CIS Level 1 controls, with Kubernetes exceptions. Lower disruption, good starting posture.

level2-tke.label: Level 1 + Level 2 (TKE-safe)
level2-tke.description: Full Level 1 and Level 2, with Kubernetes exceptions. Highest hardening that still boots and joins TKE.

phase1-section1.label: Phase 1 — Section 1 only
phase1-section1.description: Filesystem/SELinux/crypto only. Matches the incremental rollout phase; useful for early validation.

custom.label: Custom
custom.description: Start from all sections on + TKE-safe, then the UI lets the user toggle individual controls. Dangerous (breaking) controls are guarded.
